messages:
Incident Bot: PAGER: smart-routing policy misfire — multiple fallbacks observed for model selection in eu-west-1, significant latencies and a subset of requests served with wrong variant :rotating_light:
oncall-pager: paging Jordan H (primary oncall)
Jordan H: on it, joining
Samira K: seeing alerts: 5xx spike + model mismatch traces. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/routing/fallbacks
Tasha L: customer reports of 'short' responses (prob smaller variant) from several EU tenants via CS ticket #4829
Alex M: looks like chain: primary variant -> fallback-variant-a -> fallback-variant-b -> region-fallback -> loop back to fallback-variant-a (??) — getting repeated hops
Jordan H: can someone paste the routing policy snippet? I want to check the fallback order and the variant tag keys
Samira K: here: ```yaml
policies:
  - name: customer-priority
    match: tenant in (alpha, beta)
    primary: variant-v2
    fallbacks: [variant-v1, variant-quantized]
    region_fallback: eu-west-1->us-west-2
    tag_key: route_tag
```
Jordan H: thanks. I think the problem: some older requests have route_tag unset, our decision code treats missing tag as "allowed to fallback" and then region_fallback triggers, but fallback decision doesn't append a route_tag so subsequent routing sees it as unset again -> loop
Maria S: reproduction logs from proxy show missing route_tag in decision log lines: ```[decision] tenant=alpha model=variant-quantized route_tag=none decision=region-fallback target=us-west-2```
Alex M: also saw 502s from eu-west-1 when fallback tried to spin up variant-quantized in a constrained pool
Eng-SRE-Bot: Suggested immediate mitigations: 1) disable region_fallback for policy customer-priority; 2) force route_tag propagation; 3) increase eu-west-1 pool for variant-quantized
Jordan H: applying mitigation 1 now: rolling update to policy config (canary then full) — running command: ```redwoodctl policies apply --name customer-priority --disable-region-fallback --canary=1```
Tasha L: heads-up to CS: temporary mitigation may increase latency for some tenants while staying in-region
CS-Escalation-Bot: Notifying impacted customers list: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta, tenant-gamma. Sent status note to CS queue.
Samira K: adding debug logs for decisionlogger: ```logs.level=DEBUG decisionlogger.emit=full include_route_tags=true``` — pushed to staging and will push to prod in 2m
Jordan H: can we also patch the decisionlogger to surface when route_tag was set vs. derived? Add field route_tag_source
Alex M: quick patch landed to emit route_tag_source (code hash: c3f9a2). Rolling for 10% first.
Samira K: monitoring traces: after disabling region_fallback, loop stops, but we still have many requests served by variant-quantized in eu-west-1 (some cold starts) causing increased token errors
Jordan H: root cause timeline hypothesis: config update two hours ago changed tag_key to "route_tag" but deployment omitted the variant-mapping that adds tag on initial selection. New requests without route_tag triggered fallback logic that re-evaluated region policy; missing tag caused re-eval and inadequate termination condition -> repeated fallback attempts
Tasha L: any customer-facing impact numbers?
CS-Escalation-Bot: preliminary: ~420 requests/min affected across 3 tenants, median latency increased 750ms, error rate up 1.8% for embeddings/generate routes for ~30 minutes
Maria S: we should mark this SEV2 for now — misrouted variants caused quality regressions for a small subset of high-value tenants
Jordan H: immediate next steps: 1) keep region_fallback disabled for this policy until we have tag propagation fix; 2) revert policy change that introduced tag_key if that's safe; 3) enable additional observability: route_tag_source + decisiontrace ids; 4) schedule postmortem and customer notification draft
Alex M: I'm reverting the policy change epoch to yesterday's stable config as a stopgap: ```redwoodctl policies rollback --name customer-priority --to=2026-03-14T23:58:12Z``` — executing now
Samira K: debug logs show route_tag now present on new requests after rollback. Decision traces no longer show repeated hops.
Jordan H: paging handoff: I'll stay on until clear + pair with Samira for root cause. @Tasha please prepare summary for CS and include impacted time window and mitigation steps
Tasha L: working on summary, will post an initial customer note in 15m
CS-Escalation-Bot: draft sent to CS leads for review
Eng-SRE-Bot: follow-up alerts created: decisionlogger_missing_tag, fallback_loop_detected, region_fallback_disabled
Jordan H: question for product: how do we want fallbacks to behave when tag missing? Fail closed (stop) or fail open (continue region fallback)?
Alex M: ops preference: fail closed for region_fallback, but allow in-policy deterministic fallbacks if tag absent — must be explicit in config
Maria S: long term: add unit tests that ensure route_tag is attached at selection time and decisionlogger includes source + chain
Samira K: will prepare change: decisionlogger will emit route_tag_source and chain_length; and policy compiler will assert route_tag assignment for primary selections
Jordan H: handoff note: I'm handing off to Samira (secondary) at 10:42. I'll remain reachable for 30m if anything flares.
Samira K: taking over. monitoring looks stable. We'll keep region_fallback off for policy customer-priority and push a tested fix for tag propagation in next 3 hours.
Tasha L: initial customer-facing note posted to CS ticket: "We identified a routing policy misconfiguration causing some requests to be served by a lower-quality model variant. We have applied a mitigation to stop cross-region fallbacks and restored previous policy. Engineers are working on a fix and we'll follow up with details." :white_check_mark:
Jordan H: closing checklist for oncall: incident timeline, mitigation applied, rollbacks done, observability added, postmortem owner assigned (Samira)
Samira K: postmortem owner acknowledged. Will include RCA, timeline, test additions, and customer-impact calc
Maria S: minor follow-up: add synthetic test to validate decisionlog contains route_tag for fresh selections in all regions
Alex M: note for infra: consider autoscaling variant-quantized pools in eu-west-1 to avoid cold starts causing error spikes during fallback
Jordan H: thanks everyone. Incident unpaged at 10:59 after monitoring stable for 17m. Will open postmortem thread and link CS follow-ups.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: smart-routing fallback loop mitigated; follow-up required for policy compiler and decisionlogger enhancements
